body:
Hi Magda
This is Amin from Avicenna tech team (Me and the Amin that you already know share the same name),
I'll be handling the Welsh language support on Avicenna platform, and I'll be happy to assist you
We use a service called Loco to add new localizations to the Avicenna platform. I need to add the Welsh translators to Loco to help with the translations. Finally, it would be great to share the email addresses of the Welsh translators that will help with the localization.
Looking forward to your response.
Best,
Amin

Hi Amin,

 

Apologies for slow reply.

 

Thank you for sending through the portal instructions on how to upload the translations.

 

We will sub-contract the translations and have got quotes from potential providers. But we won’t go ahead with the translations until after we’ve done the internal testing so that we are sure about the contents and wording in the app.

 

We’re thinking of sending the translator the relevant texts and then uploading them into the Loco portal ourselves.

 

Best,

Annette
